paper_title: Graph Spanners for Group Steiner Distances
classifications: Theory of computation → Sparsification and spanners
statement: We conclude this work by mentioning some problems that we deem significant. Our construction of the (1 + ε)-spanner with size O(n/ε2 ) for the singleton case requires a building time of 2k k · nO(1) , can a spanner with the same stretch and size O(f (ε) · n polylog(n)) be built in polynomial time? Regarding the single-source case, we conjecture that the dependency on k in the O(2k · n) size of our preserver is too weak. Can stronger upper bounds be proved for either the same or novel constructions? Can a lower bound that is polynomial in k and linear in n be shown?
